data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Yaretzi means 'God's dew.' This name is derived from the Hebrew words 'Yari' meaning 'dew' and 'Tzii' meaning 'God.' It symbolizes God's blessings and the freshness of new beginnings. The name Yaretzi carries the meaning “God's dew” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Yaretzi usually hope their child will grow to embody god's dew and live with faith, good character and purpose.
